en.role: Federal Service for Supervision of Communications
en.quote: We confirm that at present there is no need to restrict Telegram’s operation in Russia.
en.head: Calls were later restricted and Telegram was slowed.
en.body: In March 2024 the regulator said restricting Telegram was unnecessary “at present”. It restricted calls in the app in August 2025 and announced further restrictions in February 2026. This was a later policy change, not evidence that restrictions were considered necessary in March 2024.
